sources.document_or_page_title: Land Suitability Assessment and Crop Zoning of Bangladesh — Introduction and methodology
sources.date_note: No publication or dataset version date was visible on the reviewed page.
facts_supported: The page describes suitability assessment using agro-edaphic and agro-climatic inputs.
The page describes suitability classes and states that crop zoning is generated at upazila level.
limitations: Methodology is not itself a potato recommendation for an individual farm.
The page does not provide an effective period for the displayed datasets.
Local recommendation requires the matching verified crop and locality data; no Comilla-local data version was verified for ingestion.

sources.document_or_page_title: Suitability Map of Potato — Bangladesh map
sources.date_note: No publication or dataset version date was visible on the reviewed page.
facts_supported: The page displays Bangladesh-wide potato land-area totals by suitability class.
limitations: National aggregate area totals do not establish suitability for a specific farm, district, or upazila.
No effective date or verified downloadable data snapshot was recorded.
